newsitem.title: USA: Table - Saliva Diagnostics Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: Table - Saliva Diagnostics Q2 results.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE - For the second quarter ended June 30, 1997, revenues rose over 110 percent to $484,869 from $227,034 in the first quarter ended March 31, 1997, and increased over 300 percent from revenues of $154,674 in the same quarter a year ago. The net loss from operations for the 1997 second quarter was $962,190, compared to a loss of $1,174,901 in the first quarter of this year and a loss of $1,079,699 in the same period last year.

The company incurred an additional, one-time loss this quarter of $375,000 in costs of financing in which $2.4 million was raised in a series of private placements. The loss from operations for the 1997 second quarter before cost of financing was $0.04 per share based on 23.2 million shares.

After cost of financing, the net loss for the same quarter was $0.06 per share, compared to losses of $0.05 per share in the first quarter of 1997 on 22 million shares, and $0.05 per share in the second quarter of fiscal 1996 on 20.9 million shares. For the six months ended June 30, 1996, SDS reported revenues of $308,658 and a net loss of $2 million, or $.11 per share on 19 million shares.
